summary: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy for acute cholecystitis, converted to open due to dense adhesions and an unobtainable critical view of safety. Liver-bed bleeding, EBL ~400 mL, transient hypotension managed with crystalloid, no transfusion. JP drain to gallbladder fossa. Counts correct. Extubated in room. PACU then floor admission overnight.

complications: difficult anatomy / no critical view laparoscopically

family_update_must: surgery was switched from keyhole to an open incision
there was extra bleeding that the team controlled
patient is going to the recovery area
surgeon will speak with the family in person
